Exactly on the line the divisor is zero and the reading is infinite, which is the divergence the Physical channel reports; the strip's interior is finite but huge, so this entry also exercises what a band of overflow-adjacent readings looks like to the other channels. The region's true area is 0.030, so 0.75% of the domain; the share the report prints is 2.34%, because the 32-per-axis measure lattice has a step of 0.0625 and the strip is only 0.02 wide, so the sample cannot resolve it.
